title: What Are Directives?
description: Discover the building blocks that make Vue templates reactive and dynamic.

slides.title: Directives: Vue's Special Attributes
slides.content:
# Directives: The Magic Behind the Scenes In Vue, **directives** are special attributes that start with `v-`. They tell Vue to do something special to the DOM element they're attached to. Think of them as **instructions** you give to Vue: *“Hey Vue, whenever this data changes, update this part of the page!”* ```html

Now you see me!

``` Here, `v-if` is a directive that conditionally renders the paragraph.

slides.title: Common Directives
slides.content:
| Directive | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `v-bind` (or `:`) | Dynamically bind an attribute |
| `v-on` (or `@`) | Listen to DOM events |
| `v-if` | Conditional rendering |
| `v-for` | Loop through arrays/objects |
| `v-model` | Two-way data binding on form inputs |

We'll explore these in depth in this chapter.
